spec.problem: Complete the pending authenticated and mobile audit states for the active learner localized login screen and record evidence without bypassing the real browser authentication flow.

acceptance.text: Visible anonymous login form is accessible and responsive; required/email validation blocks malformed submissions; wrong credentials produce localized feedback without exposing backend codes; a disposable learner can sign in via the real form, retain session after refresh, and return to the requested same-locale route; authenticated state and 390x844 layout are recorded in the screen inventory.

spec.expected_behavior: The public localized login form validates required credentials, provides localized wrong-credential feedback, accepts a real learner session through its visible form, safely returns within the same locale, and retains the session across refresh; the screen remains usable at 390x844.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible Chrome audit on localhost:18081: anonymous vi login blocks empty and malformed email via native validation; wrong credentials submit POST /api/auth/login and show localized 401 feedback; fresh disposable learner was created through the visible Register UI, logged out through the UI, then signed in through the visible Login form with returnTo=/vi/exercises (POST 200, /api/auth/me 200), and the authenticated session survived a full refresh. Visiting /vi/login while authenticated still renders its public form. UI logout returned /api/auth/me 401. vi/en/ja copy rendered; at 390x844 document width stayed 390, email/password inputs were 50px and submit target 48px. No captured page/console errors; anonymous /api/auth/me 401 is expected. Existing frontend regressions cover login error localization and safe returnTo behavior.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the login screen inventory, audit state, and report checkpoint changes; no product code or learner content is changed.

classification.rationale: Visible-browser audit of the learner login screen; only durable audit evidence and lifecycle task records will change unless runtime testing reveals a locally fixable defect.
